info.name: Extract a section (item) from a 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K

params.name: url
params.description: Full URL of the filing document on SEC EDGAR.

params.name: item
params.description: Section identifier. 10-K items include 1, 1A, 1B, 1C, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 7A, 8, 9, 9A, 9B, 10-15. 10-Q items include part1item1..part2item6. 8-K items include 1-1..9-1 and signature.

params.name: token
params.description: API key (alternative to the Authorization header).

items.docs: Extract a single textual section from a 10-K, 10-Q, or 8-K filing - for example 10-K Item 1A (Risk Factors) or Item 7 (MD&A) - returning clean plain text or lightly formatted HTML.
